Download:

Adding this to existing saves wont crash them but it also wont make the ships available to you starting a new save is required for that. If you had an older version installed it is fine for your save unless otherwise stated to update; following the guidlines laid out in the next sentence. Updates are save compatible unless stated otherwise.
For best results befor updates fully remove the old mod version and back it up, until basic functionality of the new version is confirmed!
Please consult any added guides or me in case of further questions! Me being abscent for some time does not mean things are free to take!

For now the sprites are still a bit rough around some edges but they are presentable.
